text:
lina: quick heads-up — noticed search results pointing to a staging URL: /runtime/staging/ja-quickstart -> 404 when clicked from search results this morning. likely frontmatter canonical still pointing to staging host.

ds_bot: kb-lint scan: found 3 broken links referencing staging.redwood.internal in /runtime/quickstart and one in /examples/embed-snippet. filing a ticket (auto-issue #4572).

omar: I can take a tiny PR to switch those to the prod path (/runtime/quickstart). will also check for frontmatter canonical and shortlink leftovers.

yuki: this is blocking a couple of onboarding flows for JP region — priority: P2. lina do you want docs rotation to own or devs?

lina: I'll own this one (claiming). plan: open PR with sed replace + update frontmatter canonical -> prod, add a short redirect in runtime quickstart frontmatter so old links keep working. assigning omar for CR.

omar: ok. quick local test command I used:
```bash
# replace staging host -> prod host in single file (example)
sed -E -i.bak 's#https://staging.redwood.internal#https://www.redwood.inference#g' content/runtime/quickstart.ja.md
```
Will push branch and link PR.

ds_bot: link-checker: queued re-run on PR. please make sure examples/embed-snippet is updated (it still references staging in a curl example).

lina: good catch — I'll update the snippet in the same PR. ETA: EOD.

kai: if we need a CDN invalidation after the redirect lands, ping me with the path list. happy to run a targeted purge. :thumbsup:

omar: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/998 — small replacements + frontmatter redirect. left a note in the PR about the embed snippet change pending. @ds_bot could you re-run the scan?

ds_bot: link-checker: re-run started on PR#998. currently checking 12 files. I'll post results in this thread when done.

lina: thanks — if scan passes and CI is green let's merge and backfill the redirect map in infra (if needed). I'll also add myself as owner in the agents.yaml for that doc.

yuki: perfect. once merged, I'll confirm search index re-crawl (should pick up canonical change in next batch).

omar: CI green now. ds_bot: scan results?

ds_bot: link-checker: passed for replaced links. one remaining staging reference in examples/embed-snippet line 12 — flagged as TODO.

lina: updated snippet, pushed to the same branch. ps: snippet used inline host for an internal curl sample; replaced with {{ site.base_url }} and added a short comment.

omar: reviewed and LGTM. merging after squash.

kai: merged. if anyone notices stale cache hits, DM me the path.

yuki: closing the loop — search should pick this up in the next crawl. thanks all for the quick turnaround. :rocket:

lina: thanks team. created a tiny follow-up task to add a unit test to docs lint that flags staging.redwood.internal in the repo. filing after lunch.
